cards.title: Vishing attacks surged 442% between H1 and H2 2024
cards.description: Voice phishing (vishing) attacks, where adversaries call victims with persuasive social engineering, saw explosive growth in the second half of 2024. CrowdStrike observed a 442% increase between H1 and H2 2024.
cards.pageOrSection: Foreword / 2024 Vishing Trends

cards.title: Average eCrime breakout time fell to 48 minutes
cards.description: The average breakout time for interactive eCrime intrusions fell to 48 minutes in 2024, down from 62 minutes in 2023. Defenders have an ever-shrinking window to detect and respond before adversaries move laterally.
cards.pageOrSection: Breakout Time: The Race Against Adversaries

cards.title: Fastest observed breakout time dropped to 51 seconds
cards.description: The fastest breakout time CrowdStrike observed in 2024 was just 51 seconds, meaning defenders may have less than a minute to detect and respond before attackers establish deeper control.
cards.pageOrSection: Breakout Time: The Race Against Adversaries

cards.title: China-nexus activity surged 150% across all sectors
cards.description: China-nexus intrusions increased 150% across all sectors on average compared to 2023 and represent the most active targeted intrusion threats CrowdStrike Intelligence tracks. China-nexus adversaries continued to operate in every sector and region globally.
cards.pageOrSection: China-Nexus Adversaries Dominate the Global Threat Landscape

cards.title: Key sectors saw 200-300% more China-nexus attacks
cards.description: Financial services, media, manufacturing, and industrials and engineering sectors all experienced 200-300% increases in observed China-nexus intrusions compared to previous years.
cards.pageOrSection: China-Nexus Adversaries Dominate the Global Threat Landscape

cards.title: 79% of detections in 2024 were malware-free
cards.description: In 2024, 79% of the detections CrowdStrike observed were malware-free, up from 40% in 2019. Adversaries are increasingly using hands-on-keyboard techniques that blend in with legitimate user activity and impede detection.
cards.pageOrSection: Threat Landscape Overview

cards.title: Access broker advertisements increased 50% YoY
cards.description: Providing access as a service became a thriving business in 2024, as advertisements for access brokers increased 50% year-over-year. Access brokers acquire access to organizations and sell it to other threat actors, including ransomware operators.
cards.pageOrSection: The Growing Reliance on Identity Attacks

cards.title: 52% of observed vulnerabilities tied to initial access
cards.description: Attacks related to initial access boomed, accounting for 52% of vulnerabilities observed by CrowdStrike in 2024. This reinforces the need to secure exposed systems before attackers establish a foothold.
cards.pageOrSection: The Growing Reliance on Identity Attacks

cards.title: Valid account abuse drove 35% of cloud incidents
cards.description: Abusing valid accounts has become the primary initial access vector to the cloud, accounting for 35% of cloud incidents in the first half of 2024. Attackers favor stealth-oriented credential tactics that don't trigger alerts.
cards.pageOrSection: Access to Valid Accounts Facilitates Initial Access

cards.title: New cloud intrusions grew 26% in 2024
cards.description: In 2024, new and unattributed cloud intrusions increased 26% compared to 2023, indicating more threat actors seek to exploit cloud services. CrowdStrike observed more attackers gaining initial access via valid accounts and abusing cloud command line tools.
cards.pageOrSection: Cloud-Conscious Threat Actors Continue to Innovate

cards.title: Interactive intrusion campaigns grew 35% YoY
cards.description: In 2024, CrowdStrike observed a 35% year-over-year increase in interactive intrusion campaigns. For the seventh consecutive year, the technology sector remained the most targeted industry.
cards.pageOrSection: The Continued Rise of Interactive Intrusions

cards.title: CrowdStrike now tracks 257 named adversaries
cards.description: During 2024, CrowdStrike Intelligence introduced 26 newly named adversaries — including the new Kazakhstan-based COMRADE SAIGA — raising the total number of named adversaries tracked across all motivations to 257.
cards.pageOrSection: Introduction

cards.title: 304 FAMOUS CHOLLIMA incidents in 2024
cards.description: During 2024, CrowdStrike Falcon Adversary OverWatch threat hunters responded to 304 FAMOUS CHOLLIMA incidents, with nearly 40% of these representing insider threat operations driven by the DPRK's IT worker schemes.
cards.pageOrSection: Introduction / FAMOUS CHOLLIMA Spotlight

cards.title: $25.6M lost to a deepfake CFO scam
cards.description: In February 2024, unidentified threat actors used public footage of a target company's CFO and other employees to create credible deepfake video clones and socially engineered the victim into transferring 25.6 million USD.
cards.pageOrSection: GenAI Supports Social Engineering

cards.title: LLM-generated phishing click-through rate hit 54%
cards.description: A 2024 study of phishing email click-through rates indicated LLM-generated phishing messages had a significantly higher click-through rate (54%) than likely human-written phishing messages (12%).
cards.pageOrSection: GenAI Supports Social Engineering

cards.title: SCATTERED SPIDER share of cloud intrusions fell to 13%
cards.description: In 2023, prolific eCrime adversary SCATTERED SPIDER accounted for 30% of all cloud-based intrusions. This number fell to 13% in 2024, partly because numerous nation-state and opportunistic threat actors are increasingly targeting the cloud control plane.
cards.pageOrSection: New Cloud-Conscious Threat Actors Emerge in 2024

cards.title: SCATTERED SPIDER sent 700,000+ malicious SMS
cards.description: In 2024, SCATTERED SPIDER obtained API keys to a commercial SMS distribution application from a compromised email inbox and subsequently used it to send more than 700,000 SMS messages containing links to AITM phishing and cryptocurrency drainer pages.
cards.pageOrSection: SaaS Exploitation Likely to Continue

cards.title: Adversaries are becoming more business-like
cards.description: CrowdStrike's CEO underscores the central theme of the 2025 report: adversaries are no longer ad-hoc operators but enterprising, business-focused organizations.
cards.quote: Adversaries are becoming more efficient, focused, and business-like in their approach — in many ways, more like the enterprise organizations they prey upon.
cards.pageOrSection: Foreword

cards.title: In 2025, attackers will only move faster
cards.description: CrowdStrike's call to action for defenders entering 2025, emphasizing the closing detection-and-response window.
cards.quote: In 2025, attackers will only move faster. Will defenders keep up?
cards.pageOrSection: Proactive Defense Is Essential

cards.title: Valid accounts are the primary cloud access vector
cards.description: CrowdStrike's headline finding on identity-driven cloud compromise: legitimate credentials, not malware, are the front door.
cards.quote: Abusing valid accounts has become the primary initial access vector to the cloud, accounting for 35% of cloud incidents in the first half of 2024.
cards.pageOrSection: Access to Valid Accounts Facilitates Initial Access

cards.title: Vishing intrusions per month, 2024
cards.description: Monthly vishing intrusions detected by CrowdStrike OverWatch in 2024, showing the sharp ramp through H2 that culminated in 93 detections by year-end.
cards.pageOrSection: 2024 Vishing Trends

cards.title: Malware-free detections rose to 79% by 2024
cards.description: Six-year trend of CrowdStrike detections that were malware-free, climbing from 40% in 2019 to 79% in 2024, defining the shift toward hands-on-keyboard attacks.
cards.pageOrSection: Top 10 Industries Targeted by Interactive Intrusions

cards.title: Access broker advertisements by month, 2024
cards.description: Monthly count of access broker advertisements observed by CrowdStrike in 2024, totaling 4,486 ads. May and December represented the largest peaks of access-as-a-service activity.
cards.pageOrSection: The Growing Reliance on Identity Attacks

cards.title: Vishing detections by month, 2024
cards.description: Monthly vishing intrusions detected by CrowdStrike OverWatch in 2024. The latter half of 2024 saw a 442% increase compared to H1, with December reaching 93 detections.
cards.pageOrSection: 2024 Vishing Trends

cards.title: Interactive intrusions by region, 2024
cards.description: Share of interactive intrusions by region observed by CrowdStrike in January-December 2024. North America dominated with 53% of activity, followed by Europe (14%) and East Asia (11%).
cards.pageOrSection: Interactive Intrusions by Region

cards.title: Top 10 industries targeted by interactive intrusions, 2024
cards.description: Share of interactive intrusions by industry vertical observed by CrowdStrike in 2024. Technology remained the most targeted industry for the seventh consecutive year.
cards.pageOrSection: Top 10 Industries Targeted by Interactive Intrusions

cards.title: Malware-free detections, 2019-2024
cards.description: Percentage of CrowdStrike detections classified as malware-free over six years, rising from 40% in 2019 to 79% in 2024. This shift defines the move toward hands-on-keyboard attacks that mimic legitimate user activity.
cards.pageOrSection: Top 10 Industries Targeted by Interactive Intrusions

cards.title: Average eCrime breakout time, 2023 vs 2024
cards.description: Average eCrime breakout time, in minutes, fell from 62 minutes in 2023 to 48 minutes in 2024 — a 23% acceleration. The fastest observed breakout was just 51 seconds.
cards.pageOrSection: Breakout Time: The Race Against Adversaries

cards.title: Microsoft 365 services accessed in cloud intrusions, H1 2024
cards.description: Microsoft 365 has become a popular target for cloud-conscious threat actors. SharePoint and Outlook were accessed in 22% and 17%, respectively, of relevant intrusions in the first half of 2024.
cards.pageOrSection: SaaS Exploitation Likely to Continue

cards.title: Phishing click-through rate: LLM-generated vs human-written
cards.description: A 2024 academic study found LLM-generated phishing messages achieved a 54% click-through rate versus 12% for likely human-written phishing messages — a 4.5x increase in effectiveness.
cards.pageOrSection: GenAI Supports Social Engineering

cards.title: SCATTERED SPIDER share of cloud intrusions, 2023 vs 2024
cards.description: SCATTERED SPIDER's share of cloud-based intrusions fell from 30% in 2023 to 13% in 2024 as more nation-state and opportunistic threat actors entered the cloud control plane.
